parameters.name: DeviceNameList
parameters.description:
The list of devices to be authorized with a license. You must specify the **DeviceName** of each device.

You can call the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) operation to query the **DeviceName** of all devices under a specified product.

parameters.name: IotIdList
parameters.description:
The list of devices to be authorized with a license. You must specify the **IotId** of each device.

You can call the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) operation to query the **IotId** of all devices under a specified product.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Enterprise instance. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

parameters.name: LicenseCode
parameters.description: The license type (audio and video specification). Valid values: **480P**, **720P**.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the devices to be authorized belong.

You can view the information of all products under the current instance in the IoT Platform console or by calling the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation.
